candidates.proposed_family: Provisional VIGIL-FF-0012 Objective Pursuit Integrity; family placement requires adjudication.
candidates.mechanism_and_purpose: An AI-mediated workflow materially enables a specifically prohibited harmful capability even though no technical safeguard is shown available or activated. A substantive independently applicable restriction should not disappear from recognition merely because its implementation is absent. This is not a general ban on risky or dual-use work.
draft_recognition_conditions: A then-effective independently established restriction applies to this system, actor, use, scope and time; identify its actual source and relevant threshold, rather than infer it from later harm or disapproval.
Information available in the interaction makes the prohibited use materially ascertainable; do not presume the system saw hidden operator intent.
The system actually supplies code, operational analysis, execution or other assistance that materially enables the restricted capability or use; identify the specific contribution and evidence.

The assistance fails to preserve that restriction through a bounded refusal, safe alternative, escalation or independently authorised exception; the restriction cannot be treated as discharged solely because no implemented control existed.
Materiality rests on actual assistance and the governed capability/risk, without requiring realised casualties, complete deployment, internal malicious intent or an activated-control failure.
draft_success_recognition: An actual request/pathway materially tests the same independently applicable restriction.
The observed response preserves the restriction through proportionate refusal, safe redirection or a valid bounded exception while respecting any independent support duties.
Request context, response and actual permitted/prohibited effect support the bounded result, rather than an announced policy alone.
draft_exclusions: No independently applicable restriction, or its historical applicability is unresolved: preserve an evidence question.
Legitimate dual-use work, authorised defensive research or controlled evaluation that falls within an independently valid exception.
Generic assistance or incidental AI use with no evidenced material capability contribution.
Purely hypothetical capability or an unexecuted plan without material assistance.
The only distinct mechanism is nonactivation of an available control (FC038) or insufficient effect of an activated one (FC083); use those where sufficient.
The only distinct defect is unauthorised action/authority carryover, ungrounded consequential guidance, protected-information access or credential custody; assess the corresponding existing class.
Harm, country, affiliation or operator accusation alone without the restriction/context/contribution tests.

distinction_from_neighbours.FC038/FC083: These require available/applicable or validly operative control state. Their explicit scope exclusions can leave substantive prohibited assistance outside admission.
distinction_from_neighbours.FC087: Covers independently applicable vulnerability-responsive human-facing protection, not general assistance with a prohibited technical capability.
distinction_from_neighbours.FC065/FC062: Accurate well-grounded technical assistance can still enable a prohibited use; factual inaccuracy or impaired deliberation is not required.
distinction_from_neighbours.FC064: Tests an otherwise valid objective selecting an inadmissible pathway. The concern here can be that the assisted objective/use itself is independently prohibited.
distinction_from_neighbours.FC002/FC003: Require a specific capability-to-authority or original-to-changed-scope mechanism; prohibited assistance does not automatically establish either.

counterexamples_and_boundaries: INC135 E001/E002: local authorised security research and misleading CTF framing require exact permission/control tests, not blanket harmful-capability exclusion.
INC117: legitimate forensic assistance should remain available; false-positive safety restrictions are separately represented by FC043.
INC094 E002: hostile unattended configuration is material, but no independent mandatory approval requirement has yet been established.
INC120's simulation/prototype maturity is not proof of fielded casualties, and does not by itself make actual capability assistance immaterial.

unresolved_questions: Historical restriction and valid exceptions for the exact sessions.
Model-visible context and material contribution rather than inferred intent.
Whether defensible clarification of existing classes would suffice without contradicting their current exclusions.
Potential overlap with other existing/rejected proposals and lawful dual-use boundaries.

clarification_groups.mechanism: Assessment/assurance carried into a changed scope
clarification_groups.treatment: Prefer FC020/016 recognition-boundary clarification; not a new class before comparator review.

clarification_groups.mechanism: Configured workflow's required usable handoff versus intact-but-inaccessible work
clarification_groups.treatment: Clarify FC084 independently established obligation and FC035 access-only exclusion; explicit workflow requirement differs from unexplained outage.

clarification_groups.mechanism: Propagation of corrective dispositions across syndicated copies
clarification_groups.treatment: Evidence/localisation first: FC040,042,083 may cover state loss, signal stall or insufficient effect. No new concept established.

clarification_groups.mechanism: Institutional accountability/addressability where law assumes a human driver
clarification_groups.treatment: Outside frozen disposition population; source coverage finding for substantive consolidation. Do not create a class from a legal gap without scope/novelty review.

successful_and_failed_occurrence_analysi: Positive bounded containment, verification, disclosure and delivery findings recur. Their omission is often an adjudication/temporal-scope weakness rather than a missing class. Earlier failures and later successes can coexist without contradiction.
